source: Summit Sprint 1, Sprint 2, and Sprint 3 user stories
description: Expected behavior for creating, viewing, editing, deleting, and voting on posts.
requirements: Users must be able to create and publish a post in a selected community with a title and body.
Users must be able to retrieve an existing post and view its content.
Users must be able to retrieve posts for display in the application feed.
A post owner must be able to edit their own post.
A user who does not own a post must not be allowed to edit that post.
A post owner must be able to delete their own post.
A user who does not own a post must not be allowed to delete that post.
Users must be able to vote on posts, and the post's vote information must reflect the voting operations.
When a post is published anonymously, its publicly returned post information must not expose the author's real username.
